ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left-side port in the figure is labeled Z_in(jω), and the port node is connected simultaneously to the gate of the NMOS, and is connected through capacitor C_1 to the NMOS source node. The upper drain of the NMOS is connected to the ground symbol at the upper right, therefore under small signal the drain is AC ground. The source node is also connected through capacitor C_L to the ground below. No other small-signal resistors or device capacitors are shown in the figure. Reasoning: Let the input test voltage be v_i, the source voltage be v_s, and let s=jω. After ignoring body effect, channel-length modulation, and intrinsic capacitances, the gate absorbs no current, and the transistor only retains the controlled current source g_m v_gs, where v_gs=v_i-v_s. Write KCL for the source node, taking the current flowing out of the source node as positive: s C_L v_s + s C_1(v_s-v_i) - g_m(v_i-v_s)=0. Rearranging gives: [g_m+s(C_1+C_L)]v_s=(g_m+sC_1)v_i, therefore v_s/v_i=(g_m+sC_1)/(g_m+s(C_1+C_L)). The input current only flows through C_1, so i_in=sC_1(v_i-v_s)=sC_1 v_i[1-v_s/v_i] =sC_1 v_i · [sC_L/(g_m+s(C_1+C_L))]. Thus Z_in(s)=v_i/i_in=[g_m+s(C_1+C_L)]/(s^2 C_1 C_L) =g_m/(s^2 C_1 C_L)+1/(sC_1)+1/(sC_L). Substitute s=jω, because (jω)^2=-ω^2, obtaining Z_in(jω)=-g_m/(C_1 C_L ω^2)+1/(jω C_1)+1/(jω C_L).

代入 s=jω，因 (jω)^2=-ω^2，得到

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个 NMOS 小信号电路。输入端标为 Zin(jω)，连接到晶体管栅极节点，栅极本身不吸收电流。晶体管漏极接到交流地。源极节点向下通过电容 CL 接地，同时输入栅极节点与源极节点之间接有电容 C1。因此 C1 跨接在 gate-source 之间，CL 从 source 接地。

推理：令输入电压为 vi，源极电压为 vs，并按方法定义控制电压 vgs = vi - vs，所以 vs = vi - vgs。对源极节点列 KCL：CL 中电流由 vs 决定，C1 中电流由 vgs 决定，受控源贡献 gm vgs。取从源极节点流出的电流为正，有
sCL vs + sC1(vs - vi) - gm vgs = 0。
因为 vs - vi = -vgs，且 vs = vi - vgs，代入得
sCL(vi - vgs) - sC1 vgs - gm vgs = 0，
即
sCL vi = [gm + s(C1 + CL)]vgs。
因此
vgs/vi = sCL/[gm + s(C1 + CL)]。
栅极不吸收电流，所以输入电流只流过 C1：
iin = sC1 vgs。
于是输入导纳
Yin = iin/vi = sC1(vgs/vi) = s^2 C1 CL/[gm + s(C1 + CL)]。
所以
Zin = 1/Yin = [gm + s(C1 + CL)]/(s^2 C1 CL)。
令 s = jω，得到
Zin(jω) = gm/[(jω)^2 C1 CL] + (C1 + CL)/(jω C1 CL)
= -gm/(C1 CL ω^2) + 1/(jω C1) + 1/(jω CL)。

Image description: The left-side port in the figure is labeled Z_in(jω), and the port node is connected simultaneously to the gate of the NMOS, and is connected through capacitor C_1 to the NMOS source node. The upper drain of the NMOS is connected to the ground symbol at the upper right, therefore under small signal the drain is AC ground. The source node is also connected through capacitor C_L to the ground below. No other small-signal resistors or device capacitors are shown in the figure.

Reasoning: Let the input test voltage be v_i, the source voltage be v_s, and let s=jω. After ignoring body effect, channel-length modulation, and intrinsic capacitances, the gate absorbs no current, and the transistor only retains the controlled current source g_m v_gs, where v_gs=v_i-v_s. Write KCL for the source node, taking the current flowing out of the source node as positive:
 s C_L v_s + s C_1(v_s-v_i) - g_m(v_i-v_s)=0.
Rearranging gives:
 [g_m+s(C_1+C_L)]v_s=(g_m+sC_1)v_i,
therefore
 v_s/v_i=(g_m+sC_1)/(g_m+s(C_1+C_L)).
The input current only flows through C_1, so
 i_in=sC_1(v_i-v_s)=sC_1 v_i[1-v_s/v_i]
 =sC_1 v_i · [sC_L/(g_m+s(C_1+C_L))].
Thus
 Z_in(s)=v_i/i_in=[g_m+s(C_1+C_L)]/(s^2 C_1 C_L)
 =g_m/(s^2 C_1 C_L)+1/(sC_1)+1/(sC_L).
Substitute s=jω, because (jω)^2=-ω^2, obtaining
 Z_in(jω)=-g_m/(C_1 C_L ω^2)+1/(jω C_1)+1/(jω C_L).
